description: An interactive field guide to satellite megaconstellations: Iridium, Globalstar and Teledesic in the 1990s, Starlink's shells and laser links, OneWeb, Amazon Leo and China's Guowang and Qianfan; how many satellites continuous coverage really needs, why low orbits beat geostationary ones and even fibre on latency, how satellite streaks land on a telescope image, and how often Starlink dodges collisions — with counts dated October 2026.
og: 66 satellites for Iridium, over 11,000 Starlinks in orbit: coverage vs satellite count, LEO vs GEO vs fibre latency, and a telescope streak simulator with real Earth-shadow geometry — interactive, with counts as of October 2026.
brand: SWARM — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
